agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/sql.py: Comparison.right property was returning self.tokens[-2] (whitespace) instead of self.tokens[-1] (the actual right-hand operand). This caused 'comparison with keywords/floats/parenthesis' and related tests to fail with e.g. AssertionError: assert ' ' == 'NULL'. Changed the property to return self.tokens[-1], verified fix with manual checks for NULL, float, and parenthesis right-hand sides.
